title: Set up managed identity connector
subtitle: Configure the connector, trust it in Entra ID, then create and use the connection.

steps.title: Configure connector security
steps.evidence: Select OAuth 2.0 and Azure Active Directory in the connector Security tab, then choose Managed Identity under Secret Options.

steps.title: Enter app and resource details
steps.evidence: Supply the application ID, tenant ID, resource URL, and scope.

steps.title: Register trust in the app
steps.evidence: The application registration needs the connector redirect URL and a federated credential.

steps.title: Create and use the connection
steps.evidence: then create and use the connection in Power Apps or Power Automate.
